title: Dragon Ouroboros Embrace
description: A bald woman with pale lavender skin and green eyes stands beside a black demonic silhouette with glowing pink eyes and horns. A vibrant orange and yellow serpentine dragon coils around both figures in an infinity loop. In the background, a small red-robed figure stands on a treehouse platform while a glowing green cat-like creature watches from a branch.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting featuring a bald woman with pale purple skin and striking green eyes standing next to a solid black demonic silhouette with glowing pink eyes and horns. A large vibrant orange and gold serpentine dragon coils around both figures forming an infinity symbol. In the background, a red-robed wizard stands on a wooden treehouse built into an ancient tree while a glowing green feline creature stands nearby, all set against a swirling blue and purple cosmic background with intricate patterns.
